carrier_family.endpoint_extension: C(a,b;0)=0 and every q derivative at q=0 is exactly 0
carrier_family.parameter_domain: a is enclosed strictly above zero; b is any finite real ball; q in [0,Qmax] with Qmax=1/255
carrier_family.chart_rule: positive instances use q and vacuum instances use Q; physical and scaled patch interfaces are never identified

exact_q_derivative_recurrence.arithmetic: exact integer polynomial arithmetic in symbols a,b,q before directed-ball substitution
exact_q_derivative_recurrence.endpoint_rule: the displayed factorized expression is never evaluated by division at q=0; its exact extension is inserted as zero

mixed_parameter_derivatives.required_orders: u,v>=0, u+v<=2; after parameter differentiation, q derivatives j=0..12 are generated by exact symbolic differentiation
mixed_parameter_derivatives.endpoint_extension: every required mixed derivative has exact value zero at q=0 because a has a strict positive lower bound
mixed_parameter_derivatives.chain_rule: kappa,beta and kappa_bar,beta_bar state derivatives use directed Jacobian and Hessian balls from their displayed state/grid definitions; omitted mixed terms are forbidden

mathematical_envelopes.definition: B_(u,v,j)(A,B)=sup abs(d_q^j d_a^u d_b^v C(a,b;q)) over a in A, b in B, q in [0,1/255]
mathematical_envelopes.existence: the exact flat extensions make every displayed supremum finite on a compact parameter box with inf(A)>0
mathematical_envelopes.required_inventory: all triples u,v,j with u+v<=2 and 0<=j<=12
mathematical_envelopes.producer_freedom: primary and independent producers may use different validated maximization algorithms but must enclose the same mathematical suprema
mathematical_envelopes.failure: a missing, nonfinite, negative or non-outward enclosure is terminal FAIL

chebyshev_pullback.tail_map: q(theta)=(1-cos(theta))/510 for theta in [0,pi] (replace q by Q on the vacuum chart)
chebyshev_pullback.twelfth_derivative: g^(12)=sum_(j=1)^12 d_q^j C * Bell_(12,j)(q',q'',...,q^(13-j)); g^(12)(0)=0 by flat extension
chebyshev_pullback.B_theta_12: the outward supremum of abs(g^(12)) assembled from the required B_(0,0,j) and exact trigonometric derivative bounds
chebyshev_pullback.coefficient_definition: c_0=pi^-1*integral_0^pi g(theta)dtheta and c_k=2*pi^-1*integral_0^pi g(theta)cos(k*theta)dtheta for k>=1
chebyshev_pullback.integration_by_parts_bound: abs(c_k)<=2*B_theta_12/k^12 for k>=1; all boundary terms vanish because g is even about theta=0 and theta=pi
chebyshev_pullback.mixed_carrier_norms: apply the identical pullback and 556 bound to every required mixed parameter derivative

remainder_operator.full_tail_state: the exact C-infinity D,S,H,K or Dbar,Sbar,Hbar,Kbar coefficient state from grid v2
remainder_operator.formal_germ: the unique triangular power-series germ from the chart-specific endpoint recurrence
remainder_operator.flat_remainder: R_X=X-X_formal for X in the four factored tail variables; every q or Q Taylor coefficient of R_X at zero is exactly zero
remainder_operator.exact_residual_split: F_full=F_formal+F_flat, where F_flat is obtained by exact expression-tree subtraction before any interval evaluation
bound_assembly: enclose every carrier and required state derivative in the correct order-8, order-6 or order-4 coefficient space
apply multiplication norm 1 and the frozen coordinate derivative constants
apply directed Jacobian/Hessian chain rules for state-dependent carrier parameters
sum every outward contribution without cancellation unless exact symbolic cancellation occurred before interval ingress
remainder_operator.Y_use: the full residual, including F_flat, contributes to Y; the formal germ alone can never satisfy Y
remainder_operator.Z_use: all first and second state derivatives of F_flat contribute to Z1 and Z2
remainder_operator.tail_projection_rule: finite DCT/collocation output is not a tail proof; the weighted infinite coefficient envelope must be recorded separately

required_fields: parameter balls A and B for all six carrier instances
B_theta_12 and weighted coefficient norm per mixed derivative
proof_record_abi.strictness: every required upper bound must be finite and nonnegative; every strict lower parameter margin must be positive
proof_record_abi.missing_or_touching: missing fields, a kappa lower bound touching zero, an undecidable comparison or an invalid ball is FAIL

allowed: manufactured positive a and finite b
